card_title: Spatial-TTT Brings Streaming 3D Spatial Understanding to Video AI
card_summary: A new AI model learns to track and understand 3D spaces from long video streams by adapting its memory on the fly.

card_title: New Benchmark Reveals AI Agents Use Brute Force, Not Strategy, to Search.
card_summary: A study finds AI agents match humans in accuracy but rely on trial-and-error rather than planning.

card_title: IndexCache Speeds Up Sparse Attention by Reusing Data Across Layers
card_summary: A new method cuts 75% of attention computations in large AI models by sharing work between similar layers.

card_title: Video-Based Reward Model Judges If Computer-Using Agents Complete Tasks
card_summary: A new model watches screen recordings to judge whether AI agents successfully completed user tasks.

card_title: DreamVideo-Omni Controls Multiple Characters and Motions in AI Video
card_summary: A new AI framework generates videos with precise control over multiple characters' looks and movements.
